description: Add, change or remove a character or object in a shot (shot_id, or scene + shot; left out: the shot on screen). op add needs ref (a character or object id of the style); change and remove need member (its id from get_shot, or its name). Ids must come from the current style: call library to see them (a wrong id is refused with the valid list). A character added without x is spaced out automatically. Returns the shot and member ids. One undo step for the person. To make the cast move or feel something, use direct_cast; for animation over time, use set_keyframes.

accessory.description: hat, crown, party, bow (only characters that can dress), or "".

auto_x.description: change: true lets the scene space it out again.

name.description: A name for this member, like 'Mia'. Used by direct_cast and in undo notes.

pose.description: A pose id the character offers.

ref.description: Character or object id (add), or a new one of the same kind (change swaps it).

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

spin.description: Degrees, turning in the picture like a wheel.

turn.description: Degrees, turning round like on a stage.

x.description: Left (-) to right (+); about -8 to 8 is in frame.

y.description: Height above the ground; 0 stands on it.

z.description: Near (+) to far (-); 0 is the front line.

name: set_cast
